# Agent (Microsoft)

GitHub says agent in the industry's sense of an [agent][industry.agent] ([About Copilot in the cloud][m7]), while VS Code calls the same products [harnesses][microsoft.agent-harness].

## Examples

- GitHub Copilot in VS Code's agent mode ([Build with agents][m3]), and Copilot CLI.
- Copilot in the cloud, so named from 28 October 2026 and formerly the Copilot coding agent ([About Copilot in the cloud][m7], [Copilot coding agent in Slack][m6]).
